Insight intelligence

Dashboards stay alive with narrative context, not just charts.

Usage, quality, and momentum are measured together. The companion reveals where attention goes, which prompts deliver impact, and how costs are trending—all while linking back to the exact conversations that created each insight.

Companion analytics Live view

Trace the health of sessions, prompts, API fetches, and downstream actions. Filter by team, data domain, or campaign and understand how the assistant amplifies impact.

Insight turnarounds
4.6× faster
Follow-up adoption
78% actions
LLM cost per run
$0.05–$0.10

Narrative snapshots

Each card blends metrics with the conversation that produced them. Jump directly to the prompt, the transformation plan, or the async worker run driving the result.

Automation health Steady

Monitor worker queues, job retries, polling cadence, and refresh cycles. When the companion escalates a heavy task, you can see the outcome and cost impact immediately.

  • Ingestion enrichmentsFlowing
  • Worker retriesMinimal
  • Narrative pushesOn schedule

Configure alerts to nudge the right channel when usage spikes, costs approach thresholds, or momentum drifts.

Story-first delivery

Insights arrive as briefings your stakeholders can act on.

The companion pairs each data update with language crafted for the audience it serves. It cites sources, anticipates objections, and recommends next moves grounded in data pulled from files, APIs, and authorised web captures.

  • Contextual recall

    Jump from a chart back to the conversation that birthed it. Every insight links to prompts, transformations, API calls, and worker outputs.

  • Audience tuning

    Toggle tone and depth per audience while preserving the underlying facts. The assistant rewrites copy instantly.

  • Momentum archive

    Review how decisions evolved over time, identify seasonal patterns, and spotlight the conversations that moved the needle most.
